args.code: local pf=workspace.ParkParkWorld local m=pf:FindFirstChild("BrokenCarousel") local c=m and (m:FindFirstChild("RepairConsole",true) or m:FindFirstChild("Console",true)) if not c then return "NO CONSOLE" end game.Players:GetPlayers()[1].Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(c.Position+Vector3.new(0,4,5))) return "tp"

local m=workspace.ParkParkWorld.BrokenCarousel local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local o={} for _,k in {"IsUnlocked","IsRepaired","IsOperating","StaffLevel","BlockedReason"} do o[#o+1]=k.."="..tostring(m:GetAttribute(k)) end return table.concat(o," ").." coins="..p.leaderstats.Coins.Value.." open="..tostring(workspace.ParkParkWorld:GetAttribute("ParkOpen")).." dist="..tostring((p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position-m.RepairConsole.Position).Magnitude)
